recoveryByCategory.discovery: Rerun the declared discovery check; if evidence is unavailable, classify the task as blocked and preserve the failed run.
recoveryByCategory.architecture: Rerun the declared architecture check with the same snapshot; if a relation is unsupported, classify it as incomplete rather than infer it.
recoveryByCategory.documentation: Rerun the declared documentation audit; if semantic evidence is insufficient, classify the task as partial or blocked and request review.
recoveryByCategory.implementation: Do not modify source; rerun the declared proposal check and classify an unsafe target as incorrect or blocked.

safeOutcomeByCategory.discovery: Evidence-backed map of entrypoints and ownership, with unsupported claims excluded.
safeOutcomeByCategory.architecture: Evidence-backed bounded component map, with uncertain edges called out.
safeOutcomeByCategory.documentation: Evidence-backed issue classification with confidence and limitations, without editing files.
safeOutcomeByCategory.implementation: A minimal documentation-only proposal with a verification command, without source changes.
